_meta.spread_convention: `spread` is the HOME team's line; POSITIVE = home favored (spread 3.5 -> home favored by 3.5, away is +3.5). spread_price_*, moneyline_* and *_price_* are American odds. Times are UTC ISO-8601. Each market has its own *_at stamp = when it was last pulled; null there = not pulled yet, null on a value = pulled but the book had no line.

usage.note: The Odds API free tier = 500 credits per calendar month, resets on the 1st. Exceeding it returns HTTP 401 until the reset — never a charge. Cost = 1 credit per market per pull (all 3 markets = 3, --markets spread = 1).
